tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: the map paper. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, report cards, the order sheet.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields, table header rows, the map's outer margin.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, table rules, map graticule.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, threshold ticks on influence bars, the Semleges hatch. At least 3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk. Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps; on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The interactive accent: links, selected tab, the player's own routes and network, focus ring. As text on paper, paper-raised or verdigris-soft.

tokens.name: verdigris-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and reachable-city halos, behind verdigris text.

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Text on a verdigris fill.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Sealing wax. Only for committing orders (the seal button) and the sealed stamp on a submitted order sheet. Never for errors.

tokens.name: seal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind seal text on a sealed order sheet.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text on a seal fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Exposure (lebukás), Kiűzetés, cut-off cities, road blocks, destructive actions. Always paired with a word or icon. Text on paper surfaces or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text in toasts and chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Suspicion (Gyanú 1–2), Ingatag stability, decaying influence. Text on paper surfaces or warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warn text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success and Stabil state. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red–green. Text on paper surfaces or ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind ok text.

tokens.name: house-voros
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Vörös (gules). House colour: influence segments, crests, route strokes. A mark colour, never body text.

tokens.name: house-kek
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Kék (azure). House colour.

tokens.name: house-zold
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Zöld (vert). House colour.

tokens.name: house-arany
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Arany (or). House colour; darkened in the day theme to hold 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: house-bibor
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Bíbor (purpure). House colour.

tokens.name: house-fekete
tokens.usage: Heraldic tincture Fekete (sable). House colour; lightened in the night theme so it stays visible.

tokens.name: house-narancs
tokens.usage: Tincture Narancs (tenné). House colour.

tokens.name: house-szeder
tokens.usage: Tincture Szeder (murrey). House colour.

tokens.name: share-neutral
tokens.usage: Semleges share on influence bars, always drawn with the line-strong hatch on top.

tokens.name: share-unknown
tokens.usage: Ismeretlen (hidden) share on influence bars, drawn with a dot pattern in paper-raised.

tokens.name: map-sea
tokens.usage: Sea and lakes on the map and in the city view.

tokens.name: map-sea-line
tokens.usage: Coastline ripples, rivers, waves under ships.

tokens.name: map-relief
tokens.usage: Engraved relief: mountain hachures, field furrows, marsh tufts, tree outlines. At least 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: map-forest
tokens.usage: Tree crowns on the map and around cities.

tokens.name: map-block
tokens.usage: Ordinary house blocks in the city view.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of verdigris.

groups.name: Térképfelirat
groups.note: Alegreya SC: the lettering of old maps. City names, screen titles, house names. Never for running text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the city or house the screen is about.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Ordinary city and estate labels on the map.

groups.name: Szöveg
groups.note: Alegreya Sans for every piece of interface text. Full Hungarian coverage (ő, ű).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Az akció a következő feldolgozáskor zárul.

groups.name: Krónika
groups.note: The voice of reports: what the world tells you.

styles.name: chronicle
styles.usage: The narrative sentence of a report card.

groups.name: Számok
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for every figure that is compared: influence, costs, PP, timers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values in tables, bars and chips.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The PP counter and headline figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gap between bar segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen regions on desktop.

radius.note: Maps are cut square. Only seals and tokens are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs (top corners of the mobile sheet).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Seals, PP pips, city dots.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One elevation for things that float over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, toasts over the map.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px paper gap, then 2px solid verdigris.
